messages:
alice: FYI p95 decode latency on prod jumped ~2.5x after yesterday's merge that touched the fused-op scheduler. Short-seq workloads (<=64 tokens) are worst. Seeing repeated decode thread stalls. Anyone oncall?

deploy-bot: deploy finished by ben at 2765429000 -> roll id r-2026-03-17-2110 :rotating_light:

ben: saw the alert, repro locally with the unit harness against HEAD. bisect points at PR #8324 (fused-op scheduler reorder).

carmen: can you paste the perf profile / flamegraph? helps to see where time is going.

alice: attaching quick flame snapshot from the in-prod profiler (cropped):
```
flamegraph sample top:
- decode_task 58%
  - fused_scheduler_poll 40%
    - memcpy_async 22%
    - kernel_launch_wait 10%
- attention_kernel_fallback 18%
- io/serialize 8%
```

david: looks like the reordered scheduler is picking the fused path but skipping the prefetch step for short batches. that causes extra cuda memcpy calls in the hot path and serializes kernel launches. explains the p95 hit.

ben: i ran a local git-bisect between v2.14.1 and HEAD. culprit commit: 7d2a9f6 (prs/fused-scheduler). change was "reorder loop to favor larger batches". reproduces with shortseq harness: run `./harness/run_shortseq_perf.sh --iters 1000`.

carmen: can we do a targeted revert/hotfix while we patch the selector?

ben: plan: revert the commit and roll a hotfix to prod. commands i used locally:
```
git revert 7d2a9f6 --no-edit
git checkout -b hotfix/fused-shortseq-revert
git push origin hotfix/fused-shortseq-revert
# then create PR and deploy hotfix/r-2026-03-18-0001
```

deploy-bot: hotfix rollout started: hotfix/r-2026-03-18-0001 -> canary -> prod. watching metrics.

alice: after the hotfix p95 back to baseline for shortseq on prod. keeping canary for 30m and will promote if stable. thanks for the quick bisect. :thumbsup: 

carmen: let's add a CI perf gate for shortseq p95 to catch regressions like this. filing PERF-4812 and will add a benchmark job in the perf pipeline.

perf-bot: perf job update: CI perf job on master shows shortseq p95 +80% at 2765432165. details: http://ci.internal/perf/jobs/4812 (captures attached).

david: next steps (short):
1) keep hotfix pinned until we have selector fix and tests
2) ben to open PR restoring prefetch logic with a defensive flag
3) carmen to add shortseq perf job + regression threshold in CI
4) i'll prototype a selector that prefers prefetch when fused path chosen
5) alice to own postmortem + customer comms if needed

alice: assigning owners: ben (hotfix + patch), carmen (CI benchmark), david (selector patch), alice (postmortem). I'll update the incident channel and create the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
